description: Caches HTTP responses by normalized query parameters so reordered equivalent queries share a response and changed values use a separate response.

cases.expected_output:
request=first status=200 url=/works?mock=true&offset=20&limit=15 body=count-1
request=same_reordered status=200 url=/works?limit=15&mock=true&offset=20 body=count-1
request=different status=200 url=/works?limit=20&mock=true&offset=60 body=count-2
handler_calls=2

request=first status=200 url=/works?mock=true&offset=20&limit=15&user[]=123&user[]=124 body=values=["123","124","15","20","true"] count=1
request=same_reordered_repeated status=200 url=/works?mock=true&offset=20&limit=15&user[]=124&user[]=123 body=values=["123","124","15","20","true"] count=1
request=different_repeated status=200 url=/works?mock=true&offset=20&limit=15&user[]=125&user[]=124 body=values=["124","125","15","20","true"] count=2
handler_calls=2
